name: Adventurers' Guild (Jadestone Branch)

quest_board.title: Strange Sounds Deep in the Mine
quest_board.summary: Unexplained sounds are coming from the mine's third level, and the miners refuse to go down to work. Investigate the cause and remove the threat.

quest_board.title: Guardian of the Jade Vein
quest_board.summary: Something dwells deep in the newly discovered jade vein. The mining company is offering a high bounty to clear it out.

quest_board.title: Herb Gathering: Evening Primrose
quest_board.summary: Granny Green needs evening primrose from the hillside beyond the mine. Gather 5 stalks.
